# Integrate Components to Page Skill

## 1. Skill Overview

This skill guides AI to **analyze Figma HTML and compose a Nuxt/Vue page** by:

1. Detecting existing reusable components that match Figma HTML blocks
2. Replacing matched blocks with those components
3. Mapping remaining raw `<div>` elements to Nuxt UI components
4. Preserving all layout wrapper divs and Tailwind classes
5. Generating a clean, wire-ready page component

```
Figma HTML
    ↓
Scan src/components/common/ + src/components/elements/
    ↓
Replace matching blocks with existing components
    ↓
Map remaining <div> elements → Nuxt UI components
    ↓
Generate page component (no business logic — compose only)
```

> The page generated by this skill is a **layout shell only**. Business logic, store calls, and API calls are added separately.

---

## 2. Reusable Component Registry

Before generating any HTML, AI **must** scan and read these locations:

```
src/components/common/
  ├── BaseModal.vue
  ├── BaseSearchForm.vue
  ├── ToastContainer.vue
  └── TripCard.vue

src/components/elements/
  ├── BaseAvatar.vue
  ├── BaseBell.vue
  ├── BaseButton.vue
  ├── BaseCard.vue
  └── BaseInput.vue
```

**Matching rules** — replace a Figma HTML block with an existing component if ANY of these signals match:

| Signal | Example match |
|---|---|
| Class name similarity | `class="trip-card"` → `TripCard` |
| Semantic meaning | A search form block → `BaseSearchForm` |
| Layout structure | Card with time + price + button → `TripCard` |
| Content pattern | Input + label + error text → `BaseInput` |
| Action pattern | Rounded button with label → `BaseButton` |

> **Rule:** Always prefer existing components over generating new HTML. Only generate raw HTML if no component matches.

---

## 3. Nuxt UI Component Mapping

For Figma `<div>` blocks that do NOT match any existing component, apply this mapping:

| Detected element | Replace with | v-model? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Text input / search field | `<UInput>` | ✅ yes | Keep placeholder, type |
| Textarea | `<UTextarea>` | ✅ yes | — |
| Submit / action button | `<UButton>` | ❌ no | `type="submit"` or `@click` |
| Cancel / reset button | `<UButton>` | ❌ no | `variant="ghost"` |
| Dropdown / select | `<USelect>` | ✅ yes | Pass `options` from parent |
| Checkbox | `<UCheckbox>` | ✅ yes | — |
| Toggle / switch | `<USwitch>` | ✅ yes | — |
| Form wrapper | `<UForm>` | ❌ no | `@submit.prevent` |
| Card / panel | `<UCard>` | ❌ no | Only if no custom shadow needed |
| Divider | `<UDivider>` | ❌ no | `orientation` prop |
| Icon placeholder div | `<UIcon>` | ❌ no | Pick Heroicons name |

> **Priority:** `Base*` components > Nuxt UI components > raw `<div>`

---

## 4. HTML Detection Heuristics

AI must infer semantic type of each Figma `<div>` using ALL 5 signals:

| Signal | How to use |
|---|---|
| **1. Class names** | `bg-stone-100 outline border rounded` → input field; `rounded-full px-8 py-3` → button; `backdrop-blur shadow` → card/panel |
| **2. Text content** | "Search", "Submit", "Book", "Select" → button; "Hà Nội", "Enter email", date format → input placeholder; uppercase small label → field label |
| **3. Layout structure** | Icon + text inside bordered box → input row; multiple input rows + button in a `flex-col` → form; time + price + select button → TripCard |
| **4. Icons** | Icon div next to text div in bordered container → labeled input; standalone icon in button-sized box → icon button |
| **5. Placeholder text** | City name, date, email pattern, "Enter ..." → `<input>` field |

> **Rule:** If ≥ 3 signals agree → replace. If < 3 signals → keep the original `<div>` with a comment.

---

## 5. Page Generation Rules

### Script block
- Use `<script setup>`
- Import every component used in the template from its exact path
- Declare `ref`/`computed` only for local UI state (modal open/close, tab index)
- Do NOT add store calls, API calls, or business logic

### Template block
- Preserve ALL wrapper `<div>` elements and their Tailwind classes exactly
- Root container must have `v-bind="$attrs"`
- Replace only matched blocks — leave unmatched divs intact
- Add `<!-- TODO: wire @[event] handler -->` comment on every component emit

### What to NOT include in a generated page
```
❌ import { useXxxStore } from '@/stores/xxx'
❌ import { xxxService } from '@/services/xxxService'
❌ useRouter() / useRoute()
❌ try/catch blocks
❌ Direct axios calls
```

---

## 6. Component Wiring Comments

For every component placed in the template, AI must add wiring hint comments:

```vue
<!--
  TripCard wiring:
  Props  : departureTime, arrivalTime, busPlate, availableSeats, totalSeats, price
  Emits  : @select → handleSelectTrip(trip)
  TODO   : v-for="trip in trips" :key="trip.id" — wire trips from store in parent
-->
<TripCard />
```

---

## 7. Example Transformation

### Figma HTML input

```html
<div class="page-container">
  <div class="search-panel bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[32px] p-8">
    <!-- form fields for trip search -->
  </div>
  <div class="results-list flex flex-col gap-4 mt-8">
    <div class="trip-item p-6 bg-white shadow">
      <!-- time, bus, price, select button -->
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Generated page output

```vue
<script setup>
import BaseSearchForm from '@/components/common/BaseSearchForm.vue'
import TripCard from '@/components/common/TripCard.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div v-bind="$attrs" class="page-container">

    <!--
      BaseSearchForm wiring:
      Props : loading (Boolean)
      Emits : @search="handleSearch" → { from, to, date, passengers }
              @reset="handleReset"
      TODO  : wire loading from useAsync, wire @search to store action
    -->
    <BaseSearchForm
      :loading="false"
      @search="() => {}"
      @reset="() => {}"
    />

    <div class="results-list flex flex-col gap-4 mt-8">
      <!--
        TripCard wiring:
        Props : departureTime, arrivalTime, busPlate, availableSeats, totalSeats, price
        Emits : @select → handleSelectTrip(trip)
        TODO  : v-for="trip in trips" :key="trip.id" — wire from store
      -->
      <TripCard
        departure-time=""
        arrival-time=""
        bus-plate=""
        :available-seats="0"
        :total-seats="0"
        :price="0"
        @select="() => {}"
      />
    </div>

  </div>
</template>
```

## Figma HTML
<!-- PASTE FIGMA HTML HERE -->

## Rules
1. Scan components above — replace matching Figma blocks with existing components
2. Map remaining <div> elements using Nuxt UI mapping rules
3. Preserve ALL Tailwind classes on wrapper divs
4. Add wiring hint comments on every placed component

## 9. Anti-Patterns

AI must **never** generate code that matches these patterns in a page shell:

### ❌ Duplicating existing components
```vue
<!-- WRONG: TripCard already exists -->
<div class="p-6 bg-white inline-flex items-center gap-8">
  <span>{{ trip.departureTime }}</span>
  ...
</div>
```

### ❌ Adding store access in the generated shell
```vue
<!-- WRONG: store access belongs in the wired page, not the shell -->
<script setup>
import { useTripStore } from '@/stores/trip' // ❌
</script>
```

### ❌ Removing layout wrapper divs
```vue
<!-- WRONG: do not flatten Figma layout structure -->
<BaseSearchForm />
<TripCard />  <!-- missing wrapper divs and classes -->
```

### ❌ Skipping wiring comments
```vue
<!-- WRONG: no hint for the developer -->
<TripCard @select="() => {}" />
```

---

## 10. Quick Reference

| Task | Action |
|---|---|
| Figma block matches existing component | Replace with component + add wiring comment |
| Figma block has input field | Map to `BaseInput` or `UInput` |
| Figma block has button | Map to `BaseButton` or `UButton` |
| Figma block has card/panel (custom shadow) | Keep wrapper div + slot in Base* if needed |
| Figma block purpose is unclear | Keep `<div>` + add `<!-- could not detect -->` comment |
| Page needs store data | Add `<!-- TODO: wire store -->` comment only |
